As discussed on p.373, there is very little differ- ence in efficacy between the different groups of antidepressant drugs, and choice is often made on the basis of adverse effect profile. SSRIs such as paroxetine are widely used as an alterna- tive to the older tricyclics as they have fewer adverse effects and are safer in overdosage. References. 1. Leyman S, et al.
